title: Proclamation No. 550, s. 2013
text:
MALACAÑAN PALACE MANILA

PROCLAMATION NO. 550

DECLARING THURSDAY, 28 FEBRUARY 2013, AS A SPECIAL (NON-WORKING) DAY IN THE CITY OF TANGUB

WHEREAS, Thursday, 28 February 2013, marks the Charter Day anniversary of the City of Tangub;

WHEREAS, it is but fitting and proper that the people of the City of Tangub be given full opportunity to celebrate and participate in the occasion with appropriate ceremonies.

NOW, THEREFORE, I, PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR., Executive Secretary, by authority of His Excellency, BENIGNO S. AQUINO III, do hereby declare Thursday, 28 February 2013, as a special (non-working) day in the City of Tangub.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.

Done in the City of Manila, this 13th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Thirteen.

By authority of the President:

(Sgd.) PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR. Executive Secretary
